title: Pyne Pod Mango Strawberry Peach Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Mango Strawberry Peach 10ml E-Liquid offers a deeply luscious and vibrant fruit medley. The inhale introduces the thick, tropical sweetness of rich Mango, which is seamlessly intertwined with the jammy, familiar notes of sweet Strawberry. As the flavour settles on the palate, a soft and velvety layer of Peach emerges on the exhale, completing the trio with a beautifully rich and well-rounded fruit finish. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the luscious layers of Mango Strawberry Peach, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the bright, zesty Lemon Lime, the tropical Mango Passion Fruit, or the refreshing Strawberry Kiwi Ice.
